1 Context

TW Hya is mentioned here for historical context only.

TWA 11A and TWA 1A are different designations from TWA 1.

2 Sample and methods

TWA 1 is included in our working sample. We fitted its spectrum in this synthetic example.

TWA 9A was excluded from our working sample after the quality checks.

Synthetic claim 🪐: we classify TWA 1 as a candidate member of TWA, conditional on a future systemic velocity measurement.

3 Results

For TWA 1, we report a radial velocity of 13.2 ± 0.3 km/s. These numbers are invented for software tests.

For TWA 2A, we adopt the radial velocity reported by Example et al. (2000); we do not remeasure it.

TWA 3 is an unresolved system. We model its combined light, not the separate components.
